## 錄製前準備

1. Apple Watch 與 iPhone 都裝好 DailyMate，學習語言選日語或西班牙語（畫面好辨認），先收藏 3–4 句、練過幾句讓進度有數字。
2. 介面語言：繁中版 App 介面切繁體中文、日文版切日本語、英文版切 English。
3. 錄音：第 2 鏡要錄到手錶喇叭唸出整句（環境安靜、收音靠近手錶）。
4. 手錶畫面錄影可用 iPhone 的「鏡像輸出 Apple Watch」或直接用另一台手機近拍手腕；兩種都要是實機畫面。
5. 背景：咖啡店排隊、捷運月台這類「等待的時候」，不拍其他人的臉。

## 各平台文字

### Reddit（每週自我推廣串，英文；只在規則允許時）

```text
I made this (developer here): DailyMate, a phrase app with an Apple Watch app. 15-second demo below.

- 8,400 complete phrases, 14 topics, 84 situations, 47 learning languages
- Every topic has 200 beginner, 200 intermediate and 200 advanced phrases
- Listen with the system voice for the selected language, on iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch
- Home Screen widget: see a phrase, go to the next one, or save it
- On the watch: phrases, listening, saved items and progress
- Paid download, pay once, no subscription. No account.
- The interface comes in 50 languages, switchable inside the app

If you'd rather start free: DailyMate Lite has the whole Traveler topic at Beginner level free in any of its learning languages; the Apple Watch app and widgets are part of its one-time unlock.

Happy to answer questions about building a watchOS phrase app.
```
